description: This file contains the implementation of the Polymer IronA11yKeysBehavior, a behavior for handling keyboard accessibility features in Polymer components. It defines key mapping constants, parsing functions, and the core behavior logic for keyboard event handling and keybinding management.

methods.name: transformKey
methods.description: Converts a key string into a normalized form based on various key representations.

methods.name: transformKeyIdentifier
methods.description: Converts a keyIdentifier string from KeyboardEvent into a normalized key name.

methods.name: transformKeyCode
methods.description: Converts a keyCode number from KeyboardEvent into a normalized key name.

methods.name: normalizedKeyForEvent
methods.description: Returns a normalized key name for a given KeyboardEvent, trying .key, .keyIdentifier, or .keyCode.

methods.name: keyComboMatchesEvent
methods.description: Checks if a key combination object matches a KeyboardEvent.

methods.name: parseKeyComboString
methods.description: Parses a key binding string into an object with key, event, and modifier properties.

methods.name: parseEventString
methods.description: Splits an event string into multiple key combination objects.
